title: Rafter
summary: R'AFTER, noun [Gr. to cover; a roof.] A roof timber; a piece of timber that extends from the plate of a building to the ridge and serves to support the covering of the roof.

inlines.v: R'AFTER, noun [Gr. to cover; a roof.] A roof timber; a piece of timber that extends from the plate of a building to the ridge and serves to support the covering of the roof.
